mapper.select: SELECT u.USER_NO AS userNo, u.USER_ID AS userId, u.EMAIL AS email, u.PASSWORD AS password, u.NICKNAME AS nickname, u.PHONE AS phone, u.ROLE AS role, u.STATUS AS status, u.TEMP_PASSWORD_YN AS tempPasswordYn, u.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, u.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, u.DELETED_AT AS deletedAt, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL AS profileImageUrl, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_NAME AS profileImageName, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_EXT AS profileImageExt, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_MIME_TYPE AS profileImageMimeType, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_SIZE AS profileImageSize, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_DATA AS profileImageData FROM OFT_USER_SOCIAL_ACCOUNT sa JOIN OFT_USERS u ON u.USER_NO = sa.USER_NO WHERE sa.PROVIDER = #{provider} AND sa.PROVIDER_USER_ID = #{providerUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OFT_USER_SOCIAL_ACCOUNT ( USER_NO, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_USER_ID, PROVIDER_EMAIL ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, #{providerEmail} )
